evaluation.name: UDIS++ 2023, section 4.2.1 and official Warp/Codes/test.py
evaluation.preprocessing: OpenCV color decode, original 512x512 test images, float32 normalized to [-1,1].
evaluation.matching: Our feature pipeline: ratio=0.78 and mutual nearest neighbor.
evaluation.estimator: Our normalized DLT/RANSAC, seed=42, threshold=3px; at least 12 inliers and 20% inlier ratio.
evaluation.photometry: Warp input2 into input1 with bilinear interpolation; apply the warped all-ones mask to both color images; PSNR over the entire image; per-channel SSIM (7x7 uniform window, sample covariance), data_range=255; no mask erosion, cropping or blending.
evaluation.failure_policy: Identity warp on estimation failure (paper section 4.2.1); every test pair contributes to PSNR/SSIM.
evaluation.comparability: 测试集与指标口径对齐；匹配和图像变形实现不同。

dataset_protocol: Complete official testing split: 1106 filename-matched pairs. Missing input1/000001.jpg restored from UniStitch authors' supplement. No training images or test exclusions. Evaluation protocol is chosen by the benchmark runner.

xfeat.variant: sparse detectAndCompute; no XFeat* or LighterGlue
xfeat.timing: Model initialization and worker warmup excluded; pair I/O and inference included.
